description: This PHP class, Migration, is part of the OrangeHRM project and is responsible for performing database schema updates, data migrations, and configuration changes during an application upgrade to version 5.6.0. It includes methods for modifying tables, inserting permissions, handling internationalization strings, and managing OAuth/OpenID providers.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: This class handles the database migration for upgrading OrangeHRM to version 5.6.0, including schema modifications, data updates, and internationalization string management.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Main migration method that performs schema changes, data updates, and configuration adjustments during the upgrade process.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the migration, which is 5.6.0.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the language string version in the database to the current migration version.

methods.name: modifyAuthProviderTables
methods.description: Alters 'ohrm_openid_provider' table columns for URL length and status type.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper used for internationalization string operations.

methods.name: removeOpenIdProviders
methods.description: Removes or updates OpenID providers based on their provider type.

methods.name: changeGoogleProviderURL
methods.description: Updates the provider URL for Google OpenID providers.

methods.name: deleteLangStringTranslationByLangStringUnitId
methods.description: Deletes translations associated with a specific language string unit ID and group ID.
